# D&M Labs

> D&M Labs is a web design agency based in Paphos, Cyprus, building professional, mobile-first websites for small businesses in Cyprus and Greece. Websites start from €299 and are delivered in 5 to 14 days.

## About

D&M Labs is a small, dedicated web design studio. We build custom, conversion-focused websites for businesses that want to stand out online. Our work is fast, affordable, and built to rank on Google.

## Services

- Custom website design and development (from €299)
- Mobile-first, SEO-optimised websites
- Bilingual websites (English + Greek)
- Website maintenance and content updates
- Local SEO setup and Google Business optimisation
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for AI search visibility
- CMS self-editing interface (from €150)
- E-commerce and online booking integration

## Packages

- Starter: from €299 — up to 5 pages, mobile-first, SEO setup, contact form, 1 month support
- Business: from €399 — up to 10 pages, blog, advanced SEO, WhatsApp integration, 2 months support
- Premium: from €699 — unlimited pages, multilingual, custom features, priority support

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How long does it take to build a website?**
The Starter package typically launches in 5 to 7 days. Business and Premium packages take 10 to 14 days depending on scope.

**Do you work with clients remotely?**
Yes. D&M Labs works with clients across Cyprus and Greece entirely remotely via WhatsApp, email, and video call.

**Do you build websites in Greek?**
Yes. We build bilingual websites in English and Greek, and Greek-only websites on request.

**What is included in the price?**
All packages include custom design, mobile-first development, SEO setup, a contact form, and post-launch support. No hidden fees.

**What is GEO and why does it matter?**
GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the practice of structuring your website so that AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview can find and cite your business. It is the next layer of visibility beyond traditional SEO.
